title: Navigate and present an implementation deck
statement: As a developer reviewing technical work, I can move through a feature implementation deck and present the active slide so I can follow the explanation without losing my place.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Opening a feature Implementation section displays the first slide of its implementation deck.
Selecting a slide thumbnail or Previous or Next displays that slide, updates the slide position and URL anchor, and does not step into another deck.
Entering presentation mode displays the active slide without documentation chrome or Item hotspots, and exiting returns to the same active slide.
